attributes.name: language switcher presentation
attributes.definition: How a language selection control is rendered, if present.

values.definition: Separate bordered buttons, each with a flag icon, with the active one highlighted.
A dropdown menu or plain text links for language choice.
No language selector on the page.

attributes.name: primary navigation style
attributes.definition: How the main navigation items are styled and arranged, including any call-to-action treatment.

values.value: plain text row with filled accent button
values.definition: Text-only nav items in a row, plus one filled accent-colored call-to-action button.
Text-only nav items with no filled button.
Nav items styled as pills, tabs or bordered buttons.

attributes.name: navigation wrapping behavior
attributes.definition: Whether the primary navigation stays on a single row or wraps onto multiple rows.

values.definition: Nav items stay on one line.
Nav items wrap onto a second row or more.

codes.value: plain text row with filled accent button
